page_title: NAP 2-1 JUV | Napoli v Juventus 03/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Maurizio Mariani has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Referee Maurizio Mariani halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Francesco Calzona, then shows him a yellow.
90+3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia will be replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli).
90+3' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
90+2' The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Joseph Nonge Boende is replaced by Danilo (Juventus).
90' Carlos Alcaraz comes off the pitch to be replaced by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).
88' 2 - 1 Goal! The rebound fell to Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) and he fired home from close range. The score is 2:1.
88' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) threw away the opportunity to score from the penalty kick.
87' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
86' Joseph Nonge Boende (Juventus) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Maurizio Mariani didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
86' It’s a PENALTY to Napoli after the VAR review!
85' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Napoli! Let's see what he decides.
81' 1 - 1 Federico Chiesa (Juventus) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
78' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
76' Here is a change. Samuel Iling Junior is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Kenan Yildiz (Juventus).
76' Substitution. Joseph Nonge Boende (Juventus) on for Fabio Miretti.
76' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
73' Bremer (Juventus) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
72' Bremer (Juventus) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
67' Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) picks up the rebound just a few yards out of the box. He attempts to beat the goalkeeper with a fine shot, but the goalkeeper is on hand to deny him.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Cambiaso trots off the pitch and is replaced by Timothy Weah (Juventus).
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is coming onto the pitch as Matteo Politano cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' Francesco Calzona has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) replacing Hamed Junior Traore.
65' Amir Rrahmani goes off the pitch and Leo Ostigard (Napoli) comes on.
61' What a sweet touch by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Alex Meret to hold.
59' Alex Sandro (Juventus) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
53' CHANCE! Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
49' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) comes close as his long-range free kick goes a whisker wide of the right post.
47' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) for a tough tackle.
47' A pass from Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is intercepted by Alex Meret and the move breaks down.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Wojciech Szczesny makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the top right corner.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Wasted opportunity. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
42' 1 - 0 Goal! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
39' A long pass finds Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
38' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.
38' Matteo Politano (Napoli) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.

37' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Wojciech Szczesny makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target.
36' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
34' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only rattles the right post.
31' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
28' Maurizio Mariani shows the yellow card to Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) for a heavy challenge.
28' Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
27' Matteo Politano (Napoli) misses a promising chance to score from the free kick, but Wojciech Szczesny makes a decent save.
26' Bremer (Juventus) picks up a caution.
26' Bremer (Juventus) brings his opponent down. Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
24' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
22' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Maurizio Mariani had a clear view and blows his whistle.

21' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Alex Meret makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
18' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Maurizio Mariani ignores the protests.
18' Foul! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
14' Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Maurizio Mariani signals a set piece.
10' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
6' A pass from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is intercepted by Wojciech Szczesny and the move breaks down.
2' Samuel Iling Junior (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
